Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.analysis.motion

Class PixelChangeDetector

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.analysis.motion.PixelChangeDetector
public class PixelChangeDetector extends Object
Detects pixel changes between multiple images using configurable image processing techniques. This class provides a flexible pipeline for motion detection that can be customized based on specific requirements.

The detection pipeline supports the following optional steps:

  • Grayscale conversion - Reduces computational complexity
  • Gaussian blur - Reduces noise and smooths images
  • Absolute difference - Finds pixel-level changes
  • Dilation - Expands and connects nearby changes
  • Thresholding - Creates binary mask of significant changes

For multiple images (>2), the detector finds the maximum difference across all images, ensuring no change is missed. Multi-channel images are handled by taking the maximum difference across all channels.

Use the Builder pattern to configure the detection pipeline: 


 PixelChangeDetector detector = new PixelChangeDetector.Builder()
     .setMats(images)
     .useGrayscale()
     .useThreshold(50, 255)
     .build();
 Mat changeMask = detector.getChangeMask();

    • print

      public void print(int rows, int cols, int channels)
      Prints debug information for each stage of the processing pipeline. Useful for troubleshooting and understanding how the detector processes images at each step.

      rows - number of rows to print from each Mat
      cols - number of columns to print from each Mat

    • getOriginals

      public List<org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat> getOriginals()

    • isUseGrayscale

      public boolean isUseGrayscale()
      Flag to enable grayscale conversion. Converting to grayscale reduces computational complexity by working with single-channel images instead of multi-channel (BGR/RGB).

    • getGrays

      public List<org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat> getGrays()
      Grayscale versions of the original images. Only populated if useGrayscale is true.

    • isUseGaussianBlur

      public boolean isUseGaussianBlur()
      Flag to enable Gaussian blur preprocessing. Gaussian blur reduces noise and smooths images, which can help eliminate false positives from minor pixel variations.

    • getGaussianWidth

      public int getGaussianWidth()
      Width of the Gaussian kernel (default: 5)

      Height of the Gaussian kernel (default: 5)

    • getAbsDiff

      public org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat getAbsDiff()
      The absolute difference matrix showing pixel changes. Calculated after grayscale/Gaussian processing but before dilation/threshold operations. For multiple images, contains the maximum difference across all image pairs. This is a single-channel Mat.

    • isUseDilation

      public boolean isUseDilation()
      Flag to enable morphological dilation. Dilation expands bright regions in the image, which helps:
      • Connect nearby changed pixels into continuous regions
      • Fill small gaps in motion areas
      • Make motion regions more prominent

    • getDilationRows

      public int getDilationRows()
      Number of rows in the dilation kernel (default: 5)

    • getDilationCols

      public int getDilationCols()
      Number of columns in the dilation kernel (default: 5)

    • getDilationType

      public int getDilationType()
      Type of the dilation kernel elements (default: 1)

    • getDilation

      public org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat getDilation()
      Result of the dilation operation

    • isUseThreshold

      public boolean isUseThreshold()
      Flag to enable binary thresholding. Thresholding converts the grayscale difference image into a binary mask where pixels above the threshold are white (255) and others are black (0). This separates significant changes from minor variations.

    • getThreshMin

      public int getThreshMin()
      Minimum threshold value - changes below this are ignored (default: 50)

    • getThreshMax

      public int getThreshMax()
      Maximum value assigned to pixels above threshold (default: 255)

    • getThreshold

      public org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat getThreshold()

    • getChangeMask

      public org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat getChangeMask()
      The final change detection mask. This single-channel Mat contains the result of the entire processing pipeline, ready for use in motion detection.
